command.isekai_mahou.social.no_arenas: No boss arena is sealed right now.
command.isekai_mahou.social.war_fail: Failed: %s and %s are already at war (or the ids are invalid/equal).
hud.isekai_mahou.arena.releasing: The arena will be released in %s s

hud.isekai_mahou.request.hint: Click [Accept] in chat or Sneak + scroll on them
reputation.isekai_mahou.allied.broken: Your reputation dropped too low: the alliance with %s was broken.
reputation.isekai_mahou.allied.on: %s is now your allied faction: you won't hurt its members and they help you in fights.
reputation.isekai_mahou.allied.result.li: You already have %s allied factions — dissolve one first.
reputation.isekai_mahou.allied.result.lo: You need Neutral standing or better to ally with them.
screen.isekai_mahou.party.chat_tip: Toggles party chat (what you type goes only to the party). /p <message> sends a single one.
screen.isekai_mahou.party.how: To invite someone: sneak and scroll the mouse wheel while looking at the player — the interaction wheel opens (Invite, Trade, Duel, View profile). You can also use /party invite <name>. Party members can't hurt each other, kill XP is shared and everyone's health shows on the HUD.
screen.isekai_mahou.party.leave_tip: Leave the party (if you lead, the next member takes over).
screen.isekai_mahou.party.no_allies: Pick them in the Reputation tab.
screen.isekai_mahou.party.title: Party · %s/%s
screen.isekai_mahou.party.war_hint: At war: PvP is on against the enemy side.
screen.isekai_mahou.profile.title: %s's profile
screen.isekai_mahou.reputation.ally_desc: Members of an allied faction take no damage from you (hits, arrows, spells and pets), won't target you and come to help when you fight near them. Up to 3; needs Neutral standing or better.
screen.isekai_mahou.trade.status_changed: An offer changed — check it before confirming.
screen.isekai_mahou.trade.status_hint: Put items on the left; both confirm and the trade happens.
screen.isekai_mahou.trade.title: Trade with %s
screen.isekai_mahou.wheel.tip: Mouse/scroll/1–4 to choose · click or Enter to confirm · Esc to close
screen.isekai_mahou.wheel.title: Interact
social.isekai_mahou.arena.ending: The fight against %s stopped. The arena will be released in %s s.
social.isekai_mahou.arena.name: %s's arena
social.isekai_mahou.arena.protected: The arena's magic protects this place.
social.isekai_mahou.arena.resumed: The fight against %s resumed — arena sealed again.
social.isekai_mahou.arena.sealed: ⚔ %s sealed the arena! Nobody can break or build here while the fight lasts.
social.isekai_mahou.arena.victory: %s has fallen! The arena will be released in %s s.
social.isekai_mahou.duel.draw: The duel between %s and %s ended in a draw (time's up).
social.isekai_mahou.duel.left_area: You left the duel area — defeat.
social.isekai_mahou.duel.rules: Duel of up to 3 min inside a %s-block circle. Nobody dies: the final blow only knocks down.
social.isekai_mahou.hint.ally: %s belongs to your allied faction %s — you won't hurt them.
social.isekai_mahou.hint.party_member: %s is in your party — no damage between members.
social.isekai_mahou.party.chat_on: Party chat ON: what you type goes only to your party.
social.isekai_mahou.party.none: You're not in a party. Sneak + scroll while looking at someone to invite them.
social.isekai_mahou.party.welcome: You joined the party! No damage between members and shared XP.
social.isekai_mahou.request.trade: %s wants to trade items with you.
social.isekai_mahou.result.already_in_pa: You're already in a party (leave it first).
social.isekai_mahou.result.busy: You're already in a trade or duel.
social.isekai_mahou.result.not_leader: Only the party leader can do that.
social.isekai_mahou.result.self: You can't do that with yourself.
social.isekai_mahou.trade.cancelled: The trade was cancelled; items were returned.
social.isekai_mahou.trade.cancelled_by: %s cancelled the trade; items were returned.
social.isekai_mahou.trade.done: Trade with %s done: you received %s stack(s) and gave %s.
social.isekai_mahou.trade.no_space: %s has no inventory space for the trade.
social.isekai_mahou.trade.wait: An offer just changed — check it and confirm again in a moment.
social.isekai_mahou.war.pvp_hint: Players on both sides can now hurt each other (even with PvP off). The enemy city's NPCs won't trade with you.
